title: cproj project manifest (project.yml)
description: Source of truth for one project. cli-spec.md §4.2. The compose file is generated from this and never hand-edited.

name.description: Project name; also the directory name under $SSD_ROOT.

services.description: Attached services keyed by catalogue key. Absent or empty means none attached.

host_port.description: Assigned at service-add, stable for life, released on remove/delete. cli-spec.md §5.

app_port.description: Host port published for the archetype's dev server (cli-spec.md §9). Assigned once and stable, like a service's. Absent means the dev container publishes nothing.
